The total area $A$ of the region between the curve $y=3x-2{x}^{2}$ and the $x$-axis from $x=1$ to $x=\sqrt{10}$ is given by the integral expression below. What is the value of $a?$

$$
A={\int }_{1}^{a}(3x-2{x}^{2})\,\text{d}x-{\int }_{a}^{\sqrt{10}}(3x-2{x}^{2})\,\text{d}x.
$$
